# Orgin | ارجین

> راهنمای فارسی ربات مدیریت گروه تلگرام ارجین. مرجع قابلیت‌ها و دستورها README مخزن است.

Orgin is a Telegram group-management bot with member moderation, content locks, anti-spam tools, welcome and rules, group growth features, statistics, Premium options, and an AI assistant. Feature availability may depend on Telegram permissions, user role, plan, and service availability. This repository contains documentation and its website, not the bot's source code.

## Official links

- Bot: https://t.me/orginv1bot
- Support group: https://t.me/orginsupport
- Official channel: https://t.me/orginchanel
- Documentation website: https://orginlabs.github.io/orgin-bot-documentation/
- Repository: https://github.com/orginlabs/orgin-bot-documentation

## Notes

- Do not infer commands or features beyond the canonical README.
- Availability can vary by role, plan, Telegram permissions, and service status; the in-bot `/help` guide is the current operational reference.
